[b][/b][quote=-chimor;59166724] [SPoiler=Chimú Expansion to Chapapata-System overview]
[b]Chapapata[/b] is a red dwarf star, which compared to the other star systems controled by the empire, is lesser common, however for the stellar neighorhood is even more common than orange stars, the system is older than of the empire's system, being 6,2 billion years old.
The system is a compact system with about 5 rocky planets and other two, and other 2 ice giants.
[b]Châllar[/b]: our data showed this to be the first planet, it suffer from it star's destructive flares frequently, also due it distance from it star is tidally locked, it had volcanic activity in past, as it "always night" side has igneous rocks, while the side facing the star, the planet has a diameter of about 7125 km , the side facing the star burns, and shows some volcanic activty, with massive calderas expelling magma melting this side.
The empire sent a ship with drilling structures, alongside robots called Châllar-A and Châllar-B, both robots are made to resist the cold temperatures as well as to mine the resources, such as great depots of iron, aluminum and potassium, which make up "rivers" of these, which were ancient places where once magma flow.
The mining stations are administered by a single great computer, similar to the ones in Cól system, which when the depots of resources begin to hit it limits, will warn any stations close to collect the resources, the project was called a little ambitious, as it implementation would happen at most worlds in Chapapata, but if it works, will be greatly profitable.
[b]Nachì[/b].
A planet taht is too hot, suffer from it star wipping out it atmosphere, however it is known for having large canions and a "cracked" surface, when the planet was young, it geological activity was very intense, so much it pierced the surface with  many faults, and canions,  however it all "died" about less than a billion years ago, however, such faults reveal veins of many resources, which seemed very valuable.
Despite being tidally locked, the planet is not as extreme as Châllar, at  least, mining outposts could be built in "colder" areas of the planet's face turned to it star.
The planet is rich in gold and silver, the fractures can even have platinum at significant amounts, such metal is very appreciate by imperial nobility, as it is similar to silver, but so shining many jewelry made up of platinum, but due it becoming more and more scarce around the 22nd century, it became so valuable taht 5 grams of silver could be equal to 4000 Chayhuacs worth.
Gold, silver, platinum, nickel, osmiun, rhodium, lithium, iron, all kinds of resources can be find here, the planet has simple drilling structures, with robots mining from the veins of metals, but, the plans of making this the "largest mine of Chimor" are perhaps the most well known projects planned for Nachì, a great  planetary defense system, and large mining outposts.
The planet has a total diameter of about 9.910 Km.
[b]Cheburia[/b]:
Cheburia is also tidally locked, and has a  diameter of about 7.850Km, a dead....? rock with little atmosphere, the planet has a surface composed of sulfur, iron and other residues, it has some old extinct calderas.
[b]Analysis of Cheburia by the sattelite Cheburia-A[/b]
[i]The planet has a thin atmosphere of what seems sulfur, the same composes it surface, which has colours from yellow to red, also has structures similar to  calderas, the planet also shows a simple magnetic field,  which seems to protect little against the star's flares, showing it once had a active geologically speaking surface, if the Sulfur were not enough, Cheburia has 2 natural sattelites, which were denominated Cheburia-1 and Cheburia-2, the first has a diameter of 23 km, and the second around 12km, the planet shows to be tidal locked, our rovers will present more detailed reports about the surface."
[b]Rovers[/b]
[u]CheR-1.[/u]
The region around this caldera seems rich in iron and igneous rock, this planet was once active on volcanism, and it is confirmed, samples of iron and the rocks were  extracted and will be taken to the Ship.
No anomaly, no instability detected.
[u]CheR-2[/u]
The atmosphere is thin, high quantities of SO₂ detected, composing 92% of the atmosphere, contrary to previous reports, ruptures on the surface seems to emit small amounts of gas, the planet, even tho small, still seems to have geologic activities, such gases do not damage the rovers, robotic expeditions can work properly.
Sulfur crystals detected on a few ruptures on  surface were collected.
[u]CheR-3.
[/u]
After drilling the surface, layers below the current soil, below the long layer of sulfur, there are signs of...microbial life, microscopic extremophile creatures, the temperature of the layer they are in is around 60 degrees celsius, and are closer to ruptures due the sulfur soil, they seem to "breath"  hydrogen sulfide and exhale sulfur, which goes out the small vents throught the soil and goes to the atmosphere, the "geologic activity" was actually, biologic and gepçptoc, they seem to live by the geological activity of the planet which seems to be stronger than originally expected, as if they receive any light from their star, they will die.
They seems to have been stable for over  thousands of millions of  years like taht, even more possibly.
[/i]
 [b]Yehatmacá[/b]
Having a total diameter of about 15.307 KM, the only planet in Chapapata with intelligent life, the Yehat is how the specie is named, the planet has also a strong magnetic field, stronger than Erene and more than enough to protect the planet against stellar winds or flares.
The planet has no water, and being very cold, with about -40-(-70) degrees temperature, making ammonia liquid, the life is rich, tho the rotation slow, but despite this, the planet relatively thicker atmosphere allows the heat distribution to not make it freeze like a snowball, the atmosphere is composed of Ammonia, nytrogen and methane, the UV rays from it star are protected by a organic haze made from the methane and ammonia , there is no oxygen, and if a human enters here, the instant they take a sinlge breath, their eyes, throat and everything would burn, but the life seems adaptative here.
The plants here "absorb" both methane and ammonia then generate nytrogen, the other creatures use the nytrogen to breath, and methane is generated by chemosynthetic creatures on deeper sea, the plants here, due taking less light from it star, are dark, plus the brown or orange skies make the scenario look somewhat scary to those visiting, but for the Yehat, a common sight.
The planet developed life around 4,9-5,2 billion years ago, and seems to have passed throught about 3 great mass extinctions in past, but now is stable.
[b]The Yehat.[/b]
Their bodies are covered in fur, they are robust and have about 1,60m, males and females have no size differences nor weight, but their faces change, as males have bigger ears, females are thinner and longer, while males heads are bigger compared to female's.
Their eyes are special, they can see in infra-red, which is made to hunt insets, on the colder seasons where most insects hide, it is hard to hunt, so the Yehat eyes evolved to make this, how this vision work is still unknown tho.
Their existence for 3 million of years is long, but they never really "evolved" too much, they only colonized their own moon Yehatmacá-1, they communicate throught gestures and sounds, this has not yet been properly compreehended.
The Yehat have a culture of coexistence with their own planet, and perhaps this factor is what made them never properly evolve technologically, to not say most of them are nomads,  they seem to have about 500 million of them existing, they usually do not reproduce much, some do not even reproduce.
They seem to have longer lifespans, the older the Yehat, the more venered they are, they seem to have a cult of adoring ancestors.
Most of the Yehat weapons, tools and even buildings are of titanium, this resources is very abundant on their surface, and seems to have the same value as gold or Platinum in Camác, however, little contact was made until now, they seem to believe the humanity is as resistant as them due to androids being sent rather actual humans to make a first contact, they seem cautious, but do not deny to show off their own achievements.
[b]Chiôrùs[/b]
This planet is a cold rock, the last planet of Chapapata, is cold and has about 5352Km of diameter, is a cold lifeless rock, with anything of intersting about it...or maybe Chimor could not discover anything about it, probes fallen into it it craters, as it seems, everything taht enter it "orbit" fails, even if it is "normal" before being sent to Chiôrùs, more research is need to discover more about it.
[b]Chapapata belt[/b]
A old asteroid belt with not much asteroids as other "younger" systems.
[b]IGs[/b]
The Ice Giants are two planets outer the Asteroid belt, IG-1 is the biggest, with a diameter of about 49000Km and IG-2 with about 47000Km of diameter, they once seemed to act as "shields" for the inner system, but it long ended as most of the asteroids from the Belt were reduced greatly, due a somewhat proximity, many asteroids were pulled by IG-1 and made into "moons", with a number of about 30, while IG-2 has about 11 moons.

[/Spoiler]

[Spoiler=The great Platinum Famine ends]
[i]The great Platinum Famine refers to the scarcity of platinum taht happened to Chimor around the 22nd century, such metal was more appreciate by the Chimú, as it was not just shining and beautifull, was as well  very resistant to corrossion, each new bhapac or sapa, upon crowned would have a coin made of pure  platinum with their face carved, the crowns had platinum, the regalia, everything nobility and imperials  used had a little of this.
The imperial chayhuac, on it highest valuable coins(coins still somewhat common in Chimor, tho not as much as digital or paper money), every coin had platinum, but the higher the value, the more platinum it would have.
But everything changed as the Platinum reserves of Chimor become scarce, the depots ending, and almost all platinum was mined out, the crisis affected the coinage industry which plumped, coins creation stagnated, and now coins were limited only tho the nobles and imperial family.
Eventually platinum would become use for Imperial Family only, and at it worst years, for only the Sapa usage, despite stellar colonization helping a little bit, little platinum was found.
The colonization of Chapapata however, allowed Chimor to control Nachì...
"This message is sent to your most imperial majesty  Dòcásh-Techápun,  today , on the cycle 62680 of Chilla, of the 5000 year, i General Lachárô, commander of  the Chánpata-VII , announce taht the Platinum Famine is oficially is ended, the second planet of Chapapata system shows massive veins of Kalchìa(platinum), more than Camác(Erene) could ever dream of having, our sensors estimated the  surface of the planet has...250 thousands tons of platinum."
 [/i]
[/spOIlEr]
[spoiler=The great expansion]
As the words of Lachárô reached the Sapa via hologram, the emperor's eyes shine, he rise his hand, a ring of platinum shines against the light of Urûntù's light pass throught one of the palace's windows.
"The empire praises your discovery general, such planet  is clearly gift sent to us by the cosmos, keep exploring, so when you return, we will prepare a new fleet just for you"
The emperor say as he stands up from his throne an glance at the Mancu Chomuña, Kátin-Bùwamo and says.
"Order  imperial scientists to study better the star's flares, and seek support from the Elowan, i and the Thrynn  will talk, do what you must"
The Elder nods in understanding, and take off a crystal from his robe then a holographic figure appears,  the Chief-Engineer of the Thrynn, Kzara'ak, entered the transmission, he wears a simple exoesqueleton, and then says.
[i]"K'tchk"
He greets with a traditional Thrynn salute, then continue.
" Techápun, as you may know,  the fleet was already sent,  Lachárô was sent first as a fast ship to make a quick analysis of the system..."
"What about the shields, the Elowan were tasked, are they working?"
"I do not know why a man as cunning like you trusted those furry bears rather our wise engineers to such noble task, tchk, the Thrynn shields on Gw'eehbio make the cit-
"Are the shields working or not"
"Tchk...yes"
------------------------------------
Élian, a elowan in Lachárô's ship glances to the star and says.
"This star is old, about 6 billion years old, compared to younger stars of this type, Chapapata is lesser active, but still more than our(referring to Urûntù) is, at least we can decipher and know when next flares and winds are coming, in any case, we are close to  Nachì"
"[b]ENTERING PLANET[/b]"
The system announced, few minutes pass, they land, and send robots to analyse a nearby fault full of platinum veins, but, there were also found debris of a older structures, similar to eggs, made of pure platinum.
"What is this"
Lachárô says without believing.
[b]PATTERNS NON RECOGNIZED BY THE SYSTEM, POTENTIAL REMNANTS OF A PREVIOUS CIVILIZATION[/b]
Élian checks out the image closer, then says.
"This is not Elowan, Thrynn, even less human or numan, Yehat perhaps, they may know what this is, but..."
"We do not have any way of translating what they speak, at least not efficiently, we took years to completely understand the Thrynn and they understand us as well"
Lachárô responds quickly.
"We could perhaps send Androids and talk to them...or try, the AI could distinguish patterns and we could perhaps discover what a few words mean"
She says, but then the general continues.
"This is a slow yet efficient way, they  titanium, perhaps we could gift them with something valuable like we did to the Thrynn  so we could learn more..."
Before any of the two could say anything, a assistant approaches the general then says.
"Sir, Thrynn seeks permission to enter the  system, if it is safe"
"...Well speaking of the devil, yes, let them in"
Lachárô gives the permission.
-------------------------------------------------
As the  Chánpata-1 pass next to Yehatmacá, Kzara'ak looks throught his windows and says.
"Look at this surface, is dark, the seas are dark blue, but i can see the atmosphere from here...seems brown"
"Remind me to not pass a vacancy there sir"
A assistant jokes a little bit, Kzara'ak laughs a bit.
"This ship could easily outstand against Gw'eehbio atmosphere, surely, this will just be another mission, our shields better be ready."
"Yes sir."
[b]Entering Atmosphere.
.
.
.
Landing[/b]
"Urgh, even worse than i thought, look at this, the trees have black leaf, the skies are brown, at least, these close setlements seems...promising, let us give the Yehat a surprise...a robotic one"
"Sir this will not be needed-"
[i]A group of yehats with tunics with darker colours, led by a elder approached the ship, the elder man glanced at the Thrynn and then draw a single symbol at the window, and said something unknown then pointed to Chachapata,  then soon left[/i].
[b]SYMBOL SEEMS COMPATIBLE WITH PATTERNS IN NACHÌ[/b]
The system announced.
"Kh'axar(assistant's name), if i can see this drawing properly...is it a star...launching a ray?"
"Affirmative sir"
"Urgh, guess we will need to stay here for a bit longer, not risking my ship nor life for this"
[i]Transmission to Élian[/i]
[i]"Skrrrakh(idiot, stupid, but way more offensive) bear, your "analysis" did not detected this"[/i]
[i]T"he star has...irregular flares, we could not expect this[/i]"
[i]"Excuses and excuses, enough, at least i can explore Yehatmacá on this meantime"[/i]
[b]Transmission ends[/b]
----------------------------------------
[b]Personal diary of Lachárô[/b]
[i]The fate of this system is left to monkeys(humans), bears(Elowan) and lizards(Thrynn)....what a universe are we in[/i]
[/Spoiler]
Expansion image: https://ibb.co/n8bHZDkN[/quote]
[spoiler=Deciphring the eggs(or at least trying)]
Élian had on front of her one of the artifacts found in Nachì, at the other side, the same drawings made by the yehat on Kzara'ak's ship, the scanner at first analyzed the similarities between both, she glanced towards her collegue, another elowan of name  Argaal, at front of him the computer showed a 3d model of the artifact's surface, symbols of what seems like a ancient writing, he finally took a better glance at the symbols, lines and circles, alongside dots, the dots filled with black were already deciphered since Kzara'ak to mean their star, but this was all, the black dots were very present.
"We can not really do anything, this can well have a important meaning for them, mrs Élian..."
Argaal said at first after analyzing the illustrations, in response, Élian replied:
"Keep searching for patterns and catalog each one, no matter if we know their meaning or not...wait a second."
The scanners seemed to heat a little over, she immediately turned them off:
"We should replace these scanners at this point, they are models from 20 years ago, and are getting quite outdated."
She commented, but Argaal would not look at her, instead, right before the panel of the egg glyphs turning off as well the scanners did, some symbols changed with the overheat.
"The symbols changed totally after the overheat, the dots turned into a fading red, possibly due time, it should be a more alive, while some lines and dots changed...perhaps we ignored how much a civilization with thermal vision could possibly use things our eyes can not comprehend nor see, such as temperature changes."

[b] Yehatmacá.[/b]
The two androids were left from one of the spaceships on the surface of Yehatmacá, they hide between the dark trees of a next settlement.
Communication, or, sort of the yehat "speak".
A elevated figure of yehat, in front of other smaller yehat, possibly children, was gesturing toward the little ones, they seemed very concentred, and when the thermal vision was turned on by one of the androids, he detected a curious pattern.
Not only were his gestures similar to lines and dots found in the eggs, but also his blood flows seemed to alter slightly, making temperature change as he gestures, they filmed everything taht was captured, and then sent to Pùnapà to study, at the end, the androids communicated to each other:
"A key for the decipher of the eggs this can be."
.
[b]Back to the Elowans.[/b]
"Hey...after some analyzing, I noticed several pre overheat eggs end with this."
Argaal point at a symbol, the glyph had a square on top of a line with a single directed to another smaller dot and square, other smaller dots are between the two.
"Hm, perhaps, ¿ could this mean not a warning, but a [i]history[/i] in fact?"
Élian said as she catalogs it on her holograms, if it was true or not is unknown, but can potentially mean such.

[/spoiler]
